name: How to Merge Separate Video and Audio Streams Without Loss
description: Learn how to multiplex separate high-resolution DASH/HLS video streams (1080p, 4K, 8K) and uncompressed or native audio tracks into a single MP4 or MKV container with perfect lip-sync synchronization.

step.name: Input Disjoint Video and Audio Sources

itemListElement.text: Submit the source URL or upload the independent high-resolution video stream (e.g. 4K VP9 or AV1 video-only) and the corresponding audio stream (Opus or AAC).
The engine validates Presentation Time Stamps (PTS) and verifies that both streams share aligned zero-start baselines to eliminate audio drift.
Choose MP4 (for universal playback compatibility across Apple and Windows) or MKV/WebM (for advanced open codecs like VP9/AV1 + Opus).
Click 'Merge Streams'. The worker executes a direct container multiplexing operation (-c copy) without re-encoding, completing the operation in seconds.
